metadata.scenario: An individual wants to schedule a time to view an available apartment. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, my name is David Anderson. I was referred by Dorothy Henderson. Nice to meet you, David! How can we assist you today? Well, my wife is recovering from a stroke, and we need physical therapy and nursing care. I'm sorry to hear that. We can definitely help with both services. Great! Can you tell me more about the physical therapy and nursing care you provide? Absolutely! Our physical therapy services focus on post-surgery rehabilitation, mobility training, and fall prevention. We also offer skilled nursing care, which includes medication management and health monitoring. That sounds good. How do we get started? I can set up a care plan and schedule an assessment for your wife. Okay, when is the soonest we can arrange that? We have openings for assessments next week. Would Tuesday work for you? Tuesday sounds perfect. What time? How about 10 AM? That works for me. Can I get a confirmation? Sure! I’ll send you an email confirmation with the details and our office contact info. Thank you! Will you also send information about pricing? Yes, I can include that as well. Our physical therapy ranges from $110 to $140 per session. Skilled nursing care varies from $95 to $125 per visit, depending on the services needed. Okay, that sounds reasonable. Also, would you like to discuss caregiver matching for ongoing support? Yes, that would be helpful. Excellent! I’ll connect you with Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator, for caregiver matching. Perfect. How will she contact me? She’ll reach out once your assessment is scheduled, usually via phone. Great! I appreciate the help, Margaret. You’re very welcome, David! Is there anything else you need? No, that’s all for now. Thank you! Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health. Have a great day! You too, bye! Goodbye!
